summary: Generated core assets for Time Loop platformer: player sprite sheet, ghost overlay, tileset, UI elements (timeline bar, buttons), and title screen background. All generated via image service to ensure style consistency and specific requirements like translucent ghosts and clock hands.
style_guide: Pixel art style, 16-bit era aesthetic. Colors: Primary palette uses cool blues/purples for time/ghost themes (#4A90E2, #9B59B6) with warm accents for interactive objects (#F1C40F). Player is distinct white/blue. Ghosts are semi-transparent cyan/white. Tiles use muted earth tones for platforms and dark backgrounds for voids. UI is clean, high-contrast, using white text on dark semi-transparent panels.

assets.purpose: Main character spritesheet containing idle, run, jump, and fall animations.
assets.integration_notes: Use as SpriteSheet in Godot. Each frame is 32x32 pixels. Row 1: Idle (cols 1-2), Run (cols 3-4). Row 2: Jump (col 1), Fall (col 2), Empty (cols 3-4). Apply tinting for ghosts at runtime by modifying modulate color alpha.
assets.license_handling: AI-generated artwork; subject to the configured image provider's terms. No independent license verification.
assets.generation_prompt: Pixel art character sprite sheet, 8 frames total, 4 columns x 2 rows. Style: 16-bit RPG hero, blue tunic, white pants. Frame 1-2: Idle standing pose, slight breathing animation. Frame 3-6: Running cycle, left-facing, legs moving. Frame 7: Jumping pose, knees tucked up. Frame 8: Falling pose, arms out. Transparent background, sharp pixel edges, no anti-aliasing.

assets.purpose: Tileset for ground, platforms, and walls.
assets.integration_notes: Each tile is 32x32 pixels. Use TileMapLayer in Godot. 'ground_*' tiles form a cohesive earthy surface with grass tops. 'platform_single' is a floating wooden/metal platform. 'wall_full' is a solid block for vertical barriers.

assets.generation_prompt: Pixel art tileset strip, 8 tiles of 32x32 each. Tiles 1-3: Grass top edge (left corner, middle, right corner) with dirt underneath. Tiles 4-6: Dirt side edges and center fill. Tile 7: A simple wooden plank platform with metal brackets. Tile 8: A solid stone brick wall texture. Style: Retro platformer, muted greens and browns, clear grid lines.
